notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

boot.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached, or signing in through your account did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

newMenu.createFailed: The document could not be created.

drive.encryptedFolder: Its key did not verify on this device. It may be damaged, or shared by someone whose keys changed.
drive.folderMissing: It may have been moved to trash, or you no longer have access.
drive.loadFailed: Your files could not be loaded.
drive.emptyDescription: Drop files here, or use New to upload or create something.
drive.emptyReadOnly: Nothing has been shared in this folder yet.
drive.noMatchDescription: Change the type filter to see everything.
drive.undoFailed: Could not restore; open Trash to try again.
drive.zipEmpty: This folder has no files to download.
drive.zipTooLarge: This folder is over 1 GB. Use Chrome or Edge to download it as a ZIP, or download files one by one.
drive.linkFailed: The link could not be created.

name.label: Name
name.taken: Something here already has that name.
name.failed: The name could not be saved.

color.title: Folder colour
color.failed: The colour could not be saved.

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.description: People you share with get their own sealed copy of this folder's key. Subfolders are shared separately.
share.recipientHint: An email for someone on this server, or user@other-server.
share.canUploadHint: New files count against their own storage.
share.quotaHint: Optional. Leave empty for no limit beyond their storage.
share.canDeleteHint: They never delete other people's files.
share.note: Sharing again with the same person changes their permissions.
share.notFound: No one with that address. For another Kutup server use user@server.
share.failed: The folder could not be shared.

publicLink.title: Public link
publicLink.description: Anyone with this link can see and download the files directly in this folder, without signing in.
publicLink.warning: The key is part of the link and Kutup does not keep a copy. Save it now; share it only with people who should see these files.

invite.title: Invite link
invite.description: {{account}} is on another Kutup server. Send them this link; they add it under Shared with me.
invite.warning: The link works once and only for {{account}}'s account. It is not shown again.

shared.emptyDescription: Folders other people share with you appear here, including ones from other Kutup servers.

invite.title: Add a shared folder
invite.description: Paste the invite link someone on another Kutup server sent you.
invite.invalid: That is not a Kutup invite link.
invite.notFound: This invite does not exist or was already used.
invite.notForYou: This invite is for a different account.
invite.failed: The invite could not be added.

shared.leaveDescription: “{{name}}” from {{account}} disappears from your Drive. They can invite you again.

trash.emptyDescription: Things you delete stay here for a while before they are removed for good.
trash.retention: Items in trash still count against your storage and are removed permanently after the server's retention period.
trash.restoreParentFirst: Its folder is also in trash. Restore the folder first.
trash.deleteForeverDescription: “{{name}}” and everything in it are removed now.

failure.shareQuota: This shared folder's upload limit is reached.
